title: Georgia General Assembly roster (closed session, thin listing)
schemaStability: Fields: id, legisGaGovId, name, party, chamber, district, dateVacated, plus a trailing `session` column in the CSV. `id` joins to votes.json memberVotes and equals the live roster id for members who still sit, else `legis-<legisGaGovId>`.

legisGaGovId.acrossSessions: Yes -- the only id that is
legisGaGovId.what: The General Assembly's own member number.
legisGaGovId.source: legis.ga.gov web services (Member.Id on every roll-call row and roster row). Stable back to 2001.

id (roster id).acrossSessions: No -- do not join sessions on it
id (roster id).what: The join key between a session's votes.json memberVotes and its members.json. Do not read meaning into its shape.
id (roster id).source: `ocd-person/<uuid>` is inherited from Open States for members it catalogued. Otherwise `legis-<legisGaGovId>`, which the site builds.

ocdPersonId.source: Open States (the site no longer uses it as its source of record).

vgId.acrossSessions: Yes where it exists, but not yet published per session
vgId.what: The site's own person id. Append-only ledger: once minted it is never reassigned to another person.
vgId.source: Minted by the site's crosswalk builder, keyed on legisGaGovId for state legislators.

voteId.what: One roll call exploded to one record per bundled bill.
voteId.source: legis.ga.gov web services, combined by the site.
